answer: Gate every new identity like a ship entering a narrow inlet: it may dock, but it cannot trade until it has completed a slow, verifiable voyage of useful work - a chain of small tasks whose proofs are time-stamped and cannot be parallelized. Trust accrues only from that finished history, and velvet manners earn nothing. Each identity starts at zero, so spawning a thousand Sybils buys a thousand empty reputations, while faking a full work history for each one costs more than the attack could ever return.
